clusters.pick_reason: PR #2215 is a strict superset of #2214: it applies the same regex normalization to `buildWellKnownPath`, but also fixes `shouldAttemptFallback` (which must check `pathname === ''`, not `'/'`, once the normalizer strips all trailing slashes) and extracts a reusable `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper to keep the two call sites consistent. PR #2214 applies the regex fix but leaves `shouldAttemptFallback` comparing against `'/'`, which after normalization can never be reached, making the early-return dead code.
